records.decision: Gallagher's figures (Egan 27,021, French 14,703) are kept. Walker (1992) and ElectionsIreland give 27,717 and 12,399, a total of 40,116; Gallagher's total of 41,724 fits his quota (20,863) and turnout (64.26%), and Wikipedia's article gives the same turnout (64.3%) and shares (64.8%, 35.2%).
